messages:
Nora (CS): looping in team after today's smoke. couple of open items for NebulaCore private/VPC deploy: 1) log retention needs to be 365 days per their SOC, 2) KMS cross-account access needs an explicit grant pattern, 3) VPC flow delivery to their S3 bucket shows intermittent 403s during bursts. who can take which?
Sujata (Nebula PM): thanks Nora. SOC will fail the audit unless retention is 365d. our infra team prefers S3 lifecycle + Glacier transition for cost. 403s started around the burst at 09:12 UTC.
Ben (Solutions): digging in. first thing: can you confirm the S3 bucket name and if server-side encryption is SSE-KMS or SSE-S3?
Sujata (Nebula PM): bucket=nebula-priv-logs, SSE-KMS with alias alias/nebula-deploy-key. we pointed the VPC flow sink at that bucket.
Priya (Security Eng): KMS note: because the key is customer-owned, we need either a cross-account grant or an IAM role in Nebula that our ingestion lambda can assume. prefer role+key policy restriction. also need to ensure the key policy includes Principal for 'arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/priv-ingest' and a condition on aws:SourceAccount.
Ben (Solutions): 403s look like permission throttling on PutObject when encryption happens concurrently. two quick mitigations: 1) add s3:PutObjectTagging to the role, 2) increase concurrency on the collector to ramp. I'll post an envoy config tweak.
Nora (CS): assign: Ben takes S3/put errors & collector throttling (due: tomorrow AM). Priya drafts KMS key policy snippet for Nebula to apply (due: Wed EOD). Sujata to request bucket lifecycle change to 365d + Glacier transition (due: Wed by afternoon). I'll track.
Ben (Solutions): envoy collector snippet (current):
```
# collector conf excerpt
output: s3://nebula-priv-logs
max_concurrency: 12
retry_backoff_ms: 250
sse: aws:kms
```
Ben (Solutions): I'll change max_concurrency to 6 for the initial burst smoothing and add exponential backoff to reduce 403s. will validate in staging and then prod.
Priya (Security Eng): KMS policy (high-level snippet customers can paste into their key policy):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodIngest",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/nebula-priv-ingest" },
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "aws:SourceAccount": "123456789012" } }
}
```
Priya (Security Eng): notes: replace account id with Nebula's; recommend adding aws:SourceArn to restrict to the role ARN. also we'll include rotation schedule in the runbook.
Sujata (Nebula PM): quick question on rotation: SOC asked if rotation is automatic or manual. what do we recommend?
Priya (Security Eng): recommend automatic yearly rotation (365d). we can set key rotation enabled and have a documented manual rekey process for emergency.
Nora (CS): Sujata — can you confirm who will apply the key policy and lifecycle change? do you need an SRE handoff?
Sujata (Nebula PM): our infra will apply both, but they'd like the exact lifecycle JSON and the policy file so they can paste into Terraform.
Ben (Solutions): lifecycle rule example (S3):
```
{
  "Rules": [
    {
      "ID": "keep-logs-365d",
      "Prefix": "",
      "Status": "Enabled",
      "Transitions": [ { "Days": 30, "StorageClass": "GLACIER" } ],
      "Expiration": { "Days": 365 }
    }
  ]
}
```
Ben (Solutions): i'll add a small note: transition to GLACIER after 30 days to balance cost.
Priya (Security Eng): also add an S3 bucket policy allowing our ingest role PutObject and PutObjectAcl for that key with kms:EncryptionContext if you use context.
Nora (CS): infra-bot just queued a small change to the collector concurrency settings.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: collector-config-update (run: c-9902).
Ben (Solutions): once the deploy finishes i will run a 30-minute soak and post logs. if 403s drop to zero we can consider outward rollout.
Sujata (Nebula PM): we pushed the lifecycle change in staging. will promote to prod after you confirm collector behavior.
Priya (Security Eng): audit blurb for SOC packet (one paragraph):
"NebulaCore private deployment forwards VPC flow logs and application logs to the customer-managed S3 bucket 'nebula-priv-logs'. Logs are retained for 365 days with automated lifecycle transition to Glacier after 30 days. Cryptographic protection uses a customer-managed AWS KMS key (alias/nebula-deploy-key) with a restricted key policy granting Redwood a least-privileged cross-account ingest role permission to decrypt for ingestion; key rotation is enabled on a 365-day cadence. Additional emergency key rotation and rollback procedures are documented in the private deployment runbook."
Nora (CS): perfect. Sujata — that should satisfy SOC for their packet. I'll mark account health as 'green with notes' after Ben confirms the 30-minute soak in prod.
Sujata (Nebula PM): thanks all. will wait for the soak results.
Ben (Solutions): deploy finished, soak started. posting results in 30m.
Ben (Solutions): soak results: no 403s during 30m window, average put latency 120ms, no errors. rolling change to prod now.
Nora (CS): marking account health green with notes. closing thread — will keep runbook links in the workspace. if any follow-ups, reopen. thanks team!
